metadata.interpretation: Conditional p=0 timing bypasses unresolved NumericalPolicy solely to price complete commit. Actual policy always rejects. No learning value or deployable acceptance evidence. Paired bootstrap intervals are block variability, not independent-run inferential intervals. Profile sums are not headline time. Resource snapshots are observed endpoints/stages, not sampled peaks; RSS and Metal overlap and are never added.
